report:
Warning log : All transactions with SCN

Hi Team,
We have a Debezium connector deployed polling records from oracle to Kafka but however we recently observed there are many update operations that have not flown into our kafka topics from oracle DB.
On scrutinizing the debezium source connector logs as we could see warning messages indicating transactions are being abandoned.
2024-10-08 05:22:46,790 WARN [apmt-sil-tpc29-scct-n4-prod-g5-v1|task-0] All transactions with SCN
We checked on the database if the log files are present containing SCNs mentioned in the logs using the below query and we could see records are present.
SELECT * FROM GV$ARCHIVED_LOG WHERE FIRST_CHANGE#  13105258959661;
Kindly help us understand what might be the cause of this warning logs and data updates going missing.

evidence.quote: You have configured log.mining.transaction.retention.ms, which is to discard any transaction that runs longer than the prescribed milliseconds"; reporter confirmed retention.hours=1 was set

notes: Missing updates came from the configured transaction retention abandoning long transactions (the WARN is from the buffer's retention logic). A later hang after removing it went unresolved.
